senses.gloss: f. pl. (Hithpa. noun of סָדַר, as שְׁתַחְוָיָה for הִשְׁתַּחְוָיָה; cmp. אִסְתְּדִירָא, אִסְטְרִידָא) riggings, sail-yards.
units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 31:3">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXI</cite> <he>ס׳ בעולם ס׳ באדם וכ׳</he> there are sail-yards in the world, and so there are sail-yards in the structure of man, that is, his two arms.
